title: fagelia scabra
intro: Fagelia scabra, commonly known as the Rough Fagelia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Boraginaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Fagelia scabra include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and an expectorant, helping to relieve symptoms of coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include sesquiterpenoids and diterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
